result: Second review after the developer's fixes: 2 prior issues resolved, 1 still open, 2 reported as new.

findings.title: Partial refunds can exceed the original charge
findings.explanation: Still compares only the new amount with the charge; refunded_so_far is computed but unused in the check.

findings.title: Float arithmetic used for refund amount
findings.explanation: The amount still goes through float(); 1204.35 becomes 120434 cents.

findings.title: Idempotency key accepted but never sent to the gateway
findings.explanation: The new idempotency_key parameter is not passed to gateway.refund, so a client retry refunds twice.
findings.suggestion: gateway.refund(charge["gateway_ref"], amount_cents, idempotency_key=idempotency_key), plus a replay test using fake_gateway.

structured_output.summary: SQL injection and card logging are fixed. The cumulative refund limit is still open; a new idempotency bug was introduced.
